posts.content_md: its so good to be back in Holography, my wife is cancer free yahoo!!!, found this stuff while doing some repairs on my house ("Wipe-On Poly" by Watco) its hydrophobic and make a good coating for DCG and film seem to seal out water. need to test to see how long it last under water . hard to the touch at 2 hours 12 hours to full cure. it would be interesting to see if this can be used as a base for other area. (photo polymer or silver base)
